gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the head plate standard differs by Befree Advanced generation: Manfrotto says the Befree Advanced AS head has a 'full Arca-compatible attachment' that takes other makers' Arca plates, L-brackets and lens collar feet, while the older Befree Advanced head is a Manfrotto RC2 clamp whose 200PL-PRO plate fits Arca heads but which Manfrotto never says accepts third-party Arca plates.
standout_why: Finding the Universe (cited) says 'Peak Design and Manfrotto use their own plate designs, which work well but tie you into their spares' and that the Peak Design head 'can't [be swapped] for a different head later'. Manfrotto's US page for the AS contradicts the first claim, and Peak Design's $29.95 Universal Head Adapter page contradicts the second. PhotographyTalk (2026-11-12, not cited) covers part of it: it says DPReview found the 2020 BeFree Advanced head 'accepted RC2 plates only' and that Manfrotto 'now supplies a plate for both its RC2 heads and Arca-style heads'. It never names the AS or says that any Befree head now takes L-brackets or lens collar feet. Digital Camera World (cited) would not load its text, so it was not compared.
decides: For a DSLR owner who already has an Arca plate, an L-bracket or a long lens with an Arca-type foot, it confirms ChatGPT's 'Befree Advanced AS' cards are the right Manfrotto. The model number matters, because the non-AS Befree Advanced kits still sold (MKBFRTC4-BH and others) are documented by Manfrotto only as RC2 heads. It also removes Finding the Universe's 'locked into own plates' objection to both Manfrotto and Peak Design. For the cheaper SIRUI Traveler 5C, SIRUI's own 4 kg / 8.8 lb payload (against 9 kg for both Befree Advanced and 9.1 kg / 20 lb for Peak Design in PhotographyTalk's figures) limits it to light DSLR plus standard-zoom kits.

findings.value: Advanced 494 ball head with a built-in Arca-type plate holder; Manfrotto says 'Mount any gear with the full Arca-compatible attachment', naming L brackets, camera cages, telephoto lens collar mounts and other Arca-type plates; 200PL-PRO plate included

findings.value: 9 kg (19.84 lb) payload under UNI/PdR 105:2021; 1.27 kg (2.8 lb); 41 cm (16.14 in) closed; 150 cm (59.06 in) max, 127 cm (50 in) with centre column down

findings.product: Manfrotto Befree Advanced twist carbon, non-AS (MKBFRTC4-BH)
findings.label: Head clamp standard (previous generation)
findings.value: Advanced 494 head 'equipped with ... the Manfrotto RC2' quick-release; the 200PL PRO plate 'is also compatible with the Arca-type mounting system' (plate onto other heads; footnote: plate not compatible with 804RC2, MH804-3W). The page does not say the head accepts third-party Arca plates or L-brackets.
findings.source_title: Befree Advanced twist carbon tripod | Manfrotto CA
findings.note: Manfrotto Canada page; the US page for this SKU was not opened. The plate is Arca-compatible in one direction only: it fits Arca heads, but the head is documented as RC2. Payload 9 kg (19.84 lb), 1.25 kg, 41 cm closed, per the same page.

findings.product: Peak Design Travel Tripod (Carbon and Aluminum)
findings.label: Using a third-party head
findings.value: Universal Head Adapter, $29.95: 'Use Travel Tripod's ultra-compact legs with any standard 3rd party tripod head'; you remove the Compact Ball Head with the included hex wrench; works on carbon and aluminum, with or without the centre column
findings.note: Maker US store page. Its specs tab (thread size) did not render. This contradicts Finding the Universe's 'you can't swap it for a different head later'.

findings.label: Arca-type plate fit (reviewer test)
findings.value: Imaging Resource's Jaron Schneider: 'Peak Design did their best to make their tripod compatible with Arca Swiss plates' but 'not all Arca Swiss-style plates are going to work'. A Sirui plate fit; an unbranded plate failed because 'the base notch is a bit too thick'. The tripod ships with Peak's own plate.
findings.source_title: The Peak Design Travel Tripod is the Most Innovative Tripod Ever - Imaging Resource
findings.note: Named reviewer, article dated 2019-05-21. Hands-on test of plate fit.

findings.label: Load capacity / weight / folded / max height
findings.value: 4 kg (8.8 lb) load; 0.85 kg (1.87 lb); 33 cm (13 in) folded; 138 cm (54.3 in) max
findings.note: Maker spec table, row 'Carbon Fiber 5C' (5A aluminum shares the 4 kg rating). The 4 kg rating is under half the 9 kg Manfrotto states for the Befree Advanced AS.
